subject: Lumenlane: sudden latency spike + 504s — urgent
messages:
From: Jacob Morris <jmorris@lumenlane.com>

Cc: Lumenlane Platform Team <platform@lumenlane.com>, Claire Ng <cng@lumenlane.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 08:12:34 -0700
Subject: Lumenlane production — sudden latency spike + 504s

Rachel,

We started seeing a sudden spike in tail latency on our primary inference calls to your hosted endpoint (model: redwood/opt-13b) around 07:50 PT. Error rate climbed to ~15% (504 / gateway timeout) and p95 jumped from ~180ms to ~2.2s. This is affecting our checkout fraud checks and creating significant user impact. Our engineers see a pattern of backend TCP resets and some DNS lookup failures in the client logs.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether anything changed on your side (deployments, routing, peering updates)?
- Any recommended mitigations while you investigate (fallback models, region routing, temporary throttling)?

I attached a short packet capture and our SLO dashboard snapshot. Please escalate — we need an ETA for remediation.

Jacob Morris
CTO, Lumenlane

Attachments: packet_capture_20260521.pcap (pcap, 2.3MB), slo_dashboard_20260521.png (image)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Network Ops <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Support Escalations <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sales Execs <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jacob Morris <jmorris@lumenlane.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 08:25:02 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lumenlane production — sudden latency spike + 504s

Marissa / Ben — forwarding urgent customer thread. Jacob reports elevated 504s + p95 spike starting ~07:50 PT. They see TCP resets and DNS failures on their side. Packet capture attached.

High level: Lumenlane is on Dedicated (us-west) with peering through our transit partner (EdgeOne). Their traffic profile is steady; this looks like an intermittent path or resolver issue rather than model slowdown. They are on an active deal (HL-2345) and are pretty sensitive here — Vivek, flag for exec awareness (they're pushing for credits if this drags).

Please triage:
- Marissa: run BGP/peering checks, verify recent eBGP flaps or route changes for the affected POPs. Check proxy pool and connection queue backpressure.
- Ben: validate whether any recent config/rate-limiting change hit their tenant or if per-tenant proxy pool exhausted and fell back to slower path.
- Everyone: keep Jacob updated every 30 minutes.

I'll be on calls if needed.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0142
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Morris <jmorris@lumenlane.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 08:38:50 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumenlane production — sudden latency spike + 504s

Rachel / team — taking ownership of network triage. Initial findings (08:38 PT):
- No planned infra deploys in the last 24h.
- EdgeOne reports transient BGP withdraws for one transit peer at 07:46–07:53 PT that correlated with increased AS path length for traffic from Lumenlane ASN to our us-west POP.
- Our DNS resolver pool saw elevated latency (average resolve 700ms for a 5m window) likely due to a misconfigured health check ping upstream.
- Proxy queue depth on proxy-az-west-3 hit 85% briefly; we tripped a backpressure heuristic that routed new sessions to a slower fallback proxy pool in us-west-2 for ~6 minutes.

Immediate mitigations applied (08:35–08:45 PT):
- EdgeOne applied emergency repatch to peer config (stable as of 08:47).
- Increased DNS resolver concurrency and warmed cold caches for Lumenlane tenant.
- Rebalanced proxy session assignments to avoid fallback pool for Lumenlane sessions.

Result: error rate dropped from 15% -> 3% and p95 back to ~250–300ms by 08:58 PT. Continuing monitoring.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Marissa: file root-cause with EdgeOne and request full BGP flap timeline (ETA 2026-05-21 12:00 PT).
- Ben: run tenant config audit and confirm no rate-limit hits (ETA 10:30 PT).
- Rachel: coordinate comms and compensation discussion (Vivek looped).

I'll attach the short network trace and our probe timeline to the ticket.

-Marissa
Director, Network Operations (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: troubleshooting_notes.txt (log snippets, 48KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
